content:
We released lean4-markdown, a typed Lean 4 library for building and rendering Markdown documents programmatically.

The motivation: if you're generating reports or structured output from Lean 4 code, string interpolation gives you no guarantees. lean4-markdown exposes a composable DSL where headings, paragraphs, tables, code blocks, and lists are typed values, so ill-formed documents become type errors.

  • GitHub: https://github.com/predictable-machines/lean4-markdown
  • Introductory article: https://predictablemachines.com/blog/lean4-markdown-generate-markdown-documents-in-lean/

This is part of a small ecosystem we're building on top of Lean 4, alongside lean4-flow and lean4-json-schema.

Feedback and contributions are more than welcome :heart: !
